svg.aria-label: Three different fractals of dimension one half
svg.title: Three different fractals of dimension one half

g.text: Many different halves: same dimension ½, different shapes, different counts
pieces seen at scale 1/2ᵏ, divided by 2^(k/2)
A whole box has an exact corner count (2ⁿ). A half box only has a growth rate:
the count grows like √2 per halving, times a wobble that depends on the shape.
So the shape does not pin down one fractional power set; only the number 2^½ survives.
